response.sql:
WITH country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    p.death_country,
    AVG(pav.points_won) as avg_points
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.death_country
),
simple_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_points) as overall_avg
  FROM country_averages
)
SELECT 
  ca.death_country,
  ca.avg_points,
  ca.avg_points - sa.overall_avg as distance_from_avg
FROM country_averages ca
CROSS JOIN simple_average sa
ORDER BY ca.death_country;

assumptions.assumption: Exclude players with NULL death_country. The phrase 'show each death country' implies showing actual countries, not unknown/NULL values.

alternatives.interpretation: Include NULL as a separate category, capturing players with unknown death country alongside players with known death countries
